notes.title: Updated the Official version 1.0.2 and the demo version 0.2.6.
notes.notes:
We have updated the official version v1.0.2 and the demo version v0.2.6.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/5a4e8f20298c5dba8f5d657299d2828805b60a24.png[/img]
Brushed up some scenarios and adjusted translations.

[u][b]◆Main changes[/b][/u]
- Based on player feedback—“Why doesn’t the landlord simply ask the tenants ‘Are you a yokai?’”—we have added a new dialogue choice in Chapter 1 that allows you to directly pose this question.

This adjustment is intended to help players more fully experience the emotional and relational complexities that underpin the story.

Rather than focusing on whether there is a “correct” answer,
we hope this addition conveys the emotional and logical weight of choosing to confront someone.

- Added new lines to Chapters 4 and 5 to further explore Yokai impersonation and its implications.

- We have adjusted several lines in the English translation where overly liberal translations made it difficult to convey the subtle nuances of the original Japanese script and affected the difficulty of constructing “suspicious” as a form of evidence.
(Select lines in Simplified Chinese have also been adjusted accordingly.)


Whether you're playing for the first time or returning to see what's new,
we hope you'll follow the story through to its end.
If you enjoy the experience, we'd greatly appreciate it if you could leave a Steam review.

[u][b]◆Gathering strategy information, spoiler feedback, and bug reports[/b][/u].
We look forward to hearing from you on the official Discord server!
https://discord.gg/AEhsP6FFJW


We will continue to be a "Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!". Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: full version game & soundtrack is now available for sale!
notes.notes:
A Werewolf game-style social deduction adventuree "Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!"
Officially released on Friday, April 25th (JST)!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/b1a7189abc072e9acd35ee32f592a4056fd9a902.jpg[/img]

[b][u]◆Contents of the main game[/u][/b]
Prologue, Chapters 1-5, and Epilogue are included.

Estimated total playing time is [u]about 10 hours[/u].
If you are not used to “mystery games”, it may take even longer.

If you are curious about the contents of this game, we recommend that you first play [b]the free demo version[/b]. It includes tutorial elements and allows you to play until the end of the first chapter.

From the second chapter onward, the level of difficulty requires solid reasoning and consideration.
Please make sure to properly check and organize the statements that shake your notes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/97f2072bcc194f0a63e8832719357c9a909b52c1.png[/img]

Carefully gather information by interviewing the residents, and uncover the clues hidden as subtle "suspicious".
After countless rounds of deduction, the moment you finally corner the "yokai"—
You'll surely experience a sense of achievement that only this game can deliver.

[u][b]📢Contents added in the full version[/b][/u].
The full version includes the later chapters (Ch. 4, Ch. 5, and the Epilogue) that were not part of Early Access.
The story now moves from the climax ("ten") to the conclusion ("ketsu") of its dramatic arc.

Mystery hidden in the apartment - and the identity of the "Mysterious Man"?
Please come and see the moving conclusion for yourself.

*Minor bugs have been fixed since the Early Access version 0.6.2.
*Save data and achievements can be carried over directly from the Early Access version.

[u][b]◆Original soundtrack is now available[/b][/u].
It contains 19 impressive BGM songs that color the main game and the ending theme “[b]Sora wo aruku Hito[/b]” that climaxes the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/853f8a84fdb657ddf1872011db919c228e471d62.png[/img].

[u][b]◆Launch Sale Information! (April 25th - May 6th)[/b][/u].
[b]- Soundtrack[/b]
10% OFF!

[b]- Complete Bundle (full game + soundtrack)[/b]
16% OFF!
Combined with the 10% off launch sale of the soundtrack alone, the savings are even greater!

[u][b]◆Thanks to everyone[/b][/u]!
To those of you who have supported us since the trial version and early access, thank you so much for your support over the years.
It has been a hard road, but we have finally been able to complete this work.

Today, we often struggle with human relationships and the difficulties of life.
This work is a human drama that also emphasizes “growth”.
What do the residents think, what do they worry about, and how do they change?

We hope you enjoy the full version of the game, and if you like, we would appreciate your cooperation in filling out a Steam review.

[u][b]◆Gathering strategy information, spoiler feedback, opinions, and bug reports[/b][/u].
We look forward to hearing from you on the official Discord server!
https://discord.gg/AEhsP6FFJW


We will be giving out hints and exchanging various opinions when you get stuck on a strategy.
Please feel free to join us!


We will continue to be a "Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!". Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Updated the Early Access version v0.6.1 and the demo version v0.2.2.
notes.notes:
We have updated the Early Access version v0.6.1 and the demo version v0.2.2.
The following bug fixes, minor functional improvements, and translation flaws have been corrected.

[b]<Main changes>[/b]
Fixed a bug in which notes could not be taken when “LOG” was displayed on the “Examine” screen after checking the surveillance camera image with “Camera” after Chapter Two.
Fixed a bug that caused a freeze at extremely low frequency when the writing process was interrupted by a cancel operation while a memo was being recorded.
The mouse cursor is now hidden when using the keyboard or controller, so that operations do not interfere with each other.
In the tutorial, the mysterious man now mentions that the note button shakes when someone says something important during a conversation, and that the contents of a conversation can be checked in the “LOG” menu even after a week has passed.
Adjusted resolution settings and window settings to be fixed when operating SteamDeck, and changed the Discord button on the title screen to be hidden.
Fixed some speaker icons on the “LOG” screen.
The position of line breaks in the “LOG” screen was unnatural when the language setting is English.
When the language setting is Simplified Chinese, an error in the color specification of character names in some sections has been corrected.
Fixed other minor bugs and translations.

We will continue to further debug, brush up, and develop the final chapter to the full version, while reflecting your opinions and bug reports.
Thank you for your continued support.
